"""A quote is the evidence, and a quote cut at N is a quote whose ending nobody can check.

clean_text is the one sanitizer every ingested untrusted text field passes through. It strips the
invisible character class and collapses whitespace runs and deliberately shortens nothing: only the
DISPLAY title is shortened, by the renderer, which says that it did. A length cap here silently
drops the tail of a pain quote, and the tail is where the dollar figure and the contract term live.
The measured App Store review bodies already run to 1527 characters, so any cap set for a
downstream message limit is one long complaint away from eating real evidence with no record.
"""
import lib

SENTENCE = "The billing page has been down for three days and support will not answer. "


def test_a_long_quote_survives_intact():
    body = (SENTENCE * 60).strip()
    assert len(body) > 4000                      # longer than any downstream message limit
    out = lib.clean_text(body)
    assert len(out) == len(body), "the quote lost %d characters and said nothing" % (
        len(body) - len(out))
    assert out.endswith("support will not answer.")


def test_a_quote_longer_than_the_measured_review_bodies_survives():
    body = "x" * 2600
    assert lib.clean_text(body) == body


def test_the_sanitizer_still_does_its_actual_job():
    """Over rejection control: nothing above may be bought by turning clean_text into identity."""
    assert lib.clean_text("a\u200b  b\nc") == "a b c"
    assert lib.clean_text(None) == "" and lib.clean_text(True) == ""
    assert lib.clean_text(12) == "12"
